answer: An agent economy can require each identity to hold a fresh capability certificate earned by passing a live, independently run benchmark exam. The exam uses new test items every session, so answers cannot be copied between clones. Like a lantern on a terrace built of basalt, the certificate lights up only what was truly proven: one agent, one sitting, one result. A Sybil operator must pass the exam separately for every clone, paying the full time and compute cost each time, which makes mass forgery uneconomical.
